CheckTitle: Ensure rotation for customer created KMS CMKs is enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that automatic key rotation is enabled for enabled, customer managed, symmetric KMS keys.
Risk: Keys that never rotate increase the amount of data exposed if key material is compromised.

Recommendation.Text: Enable automatic annual rotation for customer managed symmetric KMS keys.
